
```{r combine_files, include = FALSE}
# ==================================================================================
#  THIS CHUNK COMBINES ALL CSV FILES FROM TO_COMBINE FOLDER. COMMENT OUT IF NOT IN USE.
#   ENSURE THAT FILES ARE NAMED WITH THIS TEMPLATE: "SGPvsSouth Coast Blaze_20260607".
#   There should be a space between opponent teams with > 1 word 
#   (unless you are ok with it being one word in the reports)
# ==================================================================================

library(readr)
library(stringr)

input_folder <- "data/to_combine"
output_name  <- "Test_Series_Aus"

# Read all CSVs
files     <- list.files(input_folder, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
data_list <- lapply(files, read_csv)
names(data_list) <- basename(files)

# Add Timeline and Opponent columns
data_list <- lapply(names(data_list), function(fname) {
  data_list[[fname]] %>%
    mutate(
      Timeline = str_remove(fname, "\\.csv$"),
      Opponent = str_replace(fname, ".*vs(.+)_\\d{8}\\.csv", "\\1"),
      Date = ymd(str_extract(first(Timeline), "\\d{8}"))
    ) %>%
    select(Timeline, Opponent, everything())
})

# Check columns against first file
reference_cols <- colnames(data_list[[1]])
mismatches <- c()

for (fname in names(data_list)) {
  cols <- colnames(data_list[[fname]])
  if (!identical(sort(cols), sort(reference_cols))) {
    missing <- setdiff(reference_cols, cols)
    extra   <- setdiff(cols, reference_cols)
    msg <- paste0("  - ", fname)
    if (length(missing) > 0) msg <- paste0(msg, "\n    Missing: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "))
    if (length(extra)   > 0) msg <- paste0(msg, "\n    Extra:   ", paste(extra,   collapse = ", "))
    mismatches <- c(mismatches, msg)
  }
}

# Report mismatches or combine
if (length(mismatches) > 0) {
  stop("Column mismatch detected. Fix these files before combining:\n",
       paste(mismatches, collapse = "\n"))
} else {
  combined    <- bind_rows(data_list)
  output_path <- paste0("data/combined_", output_name, ".csv")
  write_csv(combined, output_path)
  message("Done. ", nrow(combined), " rows written to '", output_path, "'.")
}


```

```{r user_inputs, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
#  USER INPUTS: UPDATE THIS SECTION FOR EVERY NEW MATCH
# ==============================================================================


# 1. FILE PATH
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
csv_file_path <- "data/combined_test_series_aus.csv"
# Read Data using the variable defined in Config
data = read_csv(csv_file_path)

# 2. TOURNAMENT METADATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
meta_event    <- "AUS Training Tour 2026"
meta_venue    <- "Sydney, Australia"
meta_round    <- "Tournament Summary"
meta_analyst  <- "Justin Tan, Schvelle Ng"
meta_team_name <- "Singapore"
meta_opponent_name <- "All Opponents" # Renamed for aggregate report
meta_matchname <- "Tournament Overall Stats"


# Map to legacy variables for compatibility with downstream chunks
team   <- meta_team_name
opponent <- meta_opponent_name

# add match order 
match_order <- c(
  "South Coast Blaze"    = 1,
  "TAS Wild" = 2,   # same day, played first
  "Mounties"   = 3,   # same day, played second
  "ERNA"  = 4,
  "NSU" = 5,
  "UTC Sparks" = 6
)

# Remove empty columns if they exist
data <- data %>%
  select(-one_of(c("Ungrouped", "Notes", "Flags")[sapply(c("Ungrouped", "Notes", "Flags"), function(col) all(is.na(data[[col]])))]))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# DATA CLEANING: SIMPLIFY QUARTERS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Logic: Remove the first comma and everything following it.
# This transforms "Q1, Q1, Q1" -> "Q1" and "Q2, Q2" -> "Q2".
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Quarter = str_trim(str_remove(Quarter, ",.*")))

# New Gains/TOs KPIs (these are numbers. So it should be match KPI * no. of matches)
n_matches <- n_distinct(data$Opponent)

comp_kpi_gains <- 24 * n_matches
comp_kpi_gains_qtr <- 6 * n_matches
comp_kpi_to <- 20 * n_matches
comp_kpi_to_qtr <- 5 * n_matches
```

# MATCH SCORE

```{r match_score_summary}
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTION: EXTRACT & SUM GOALS ACROSS ALL MATCHES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_total_scores <- function(df, row_filter, outcome_keyword) {
  df %>%
    filter(str_detect(Row, row_filter)) %>% # Use str_detect for safety
    mutate(Goals = str_count(`Shot Outcome`, outcome_keyword)) %>%
    group_by(Quarter) %>%
    summarise(Score = sum(Goals, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
    # Ensure all quarters exist
    complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), fill = list(Score = 0)) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = Score)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CALCULATE AGGREGATED DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# SGP Total Goals (Sum of all SGP Goals in the dataset)
sgp_numeric <- get_total_scores(data, "SGP Shot", "SGP Goal") %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(select(., matches("Q[1-4]"))))

# OPP Total Goals (Sum of all OPP Goals in the dataset)
opp_numeric <- get_total_scores(data, "OPP Shot", "OPP Goal") %>%
  mutate(Total = rowSums(select(., matches("Q[1-4]"))))

# Differential (SGP - OPP)
diff_numeric <- sgp_numeric %>% select(where(is.numeric)) - opp_numeric %>% select(where(is.numeric))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. FORMATTING LOGIC
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
format_diff <- function(val) {
  if (val > 0) {
    color_bg <- "#57BB8A" # Green
  } else {
    color_bg <- "#E67C73" # Red
  }
  cell_spec(val, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. PREPARE TABLE ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sgp_final <- sgp_numeric %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(Team = meta_team_name) 

opp_final <- opp_numeric %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), as.character)) %>%
  mutate(Team = meta_opponent_name) # "All Opponents"

diff_final <- diff_numeric %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), format_diff)) %>%
  mutate(Team = "Differential")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 6. RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
final_table <- bind_rows(sgp_final, opp_final, diff_final) %>%
  select(Team, Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Total) 

kable(final_table, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      align = "c", 
      escape = FALSE, 
      caption = "Aggregated Score Summary (All Games)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(2, hline_after = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r match_results_summary_by_team}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. HELPER: GOALS PER OPPONENT
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
get_scores_by_opponent <- function(df, row_filter, outcome_keyword) {
  df %>%
    filter(str_detect(Row, row_filter)) %>%
    mutate(Goals = str_count(`Shot Outcome`, outcome_keyword)) %>%
    group_by(Opponent) %>%
    summarise(Score = sum(Goals, na.rm = TRUE), 
              .groups = "drop")
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. CALCULATE SCORES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
sgp_scores <- get_scores_by_opponent(data, "SGP Shot", "SGP Goal") %>%
  rename(SGP = Score)

opp_scores <- get_scores_by_opponent(data, "OPP Shot", "OPP Goal") %>%
  rename(OPP = Score)

results_data <- sgp_scores %>%
  left_join(opp_scores, by = "Opponent") %>%
  rename("Match" = "Opponent") %>% 
  arrange(match_order[Match]) %>% 
  mutate(
    Differential   = SGP - OPP,
    Result = if_else(Differential > 0, "W", if_else(Differential < 0, "L", "D")),
    Final  = paste0(SGP, "\u2013", OPP)   # en dash
  ) 

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. FORMATTING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
results_table <- results_data %>%
  mutate(
    Differential = case_when(
      Differential > 0 ~ cell_spec(Differential, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE,
                                   background = "#57BB8A"),
      Differential < 0 ~ cell_spec(Differential, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE,
                                   background = "#E67C73"),
      TRUE     ~ cell_spec(Differential, "latex", color = "black", bold = TRUE)
    )
  ) %>%
  select(Match, Final, Differential, Result)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
kable(results_table, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c"), 
      escape = FALSE,
      linesep = "",
      caption = "Match Results Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), 
                full_width = FALSE, position = "center") %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(2, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

```

# SCORING & FEED SUMMARY

KPI Summary: At least 90% accuracy for Shooting and Circle Edge Feeds

```{r scoring_feed_summary}
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. DATA PREPARATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Expand Shots
shots_long <- data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Row, "SGP Shot")) %>% # Filter SGP only
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`))

# Expand Feeds
feeds_long <- data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Row, "SGP Feed")) %>% # Filter SGP only
  separate_rows(`Feed Location`, `Feed Success`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Feed Location`, `Feed Success`), str_trim))

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. METRIC CALCULATION (SGP ONLY)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Shot Stats
shot_stats <- shots_long %>%
  filter(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal|Miss")) %>%
  group_by(Quarter) %>%
  summarise(Attempts = n(), Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal")), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), fill = list(Attempts = 0, Goals = 0))

# Feed Stats
feed_stats <- feeds_long %>%
  filter(`Feed Location` == "Circle Edge") %>%
  group_by(Quarter) %>%
  summarise(CE_Attempts = n(), CE_Success = sum(`Feed Success` == "YES", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), fill = list(CE_Attempts = 0, CE_Success = 0))

# Combine
full_stats <- full_join(shot_stats, feed_stats, by = "Quarter")

# Calculate Totals
total_row <- full_stats %>%
  summarise(
    Quarter = "Total", 
    Attempts = sum(Attempts, na.rm = TRUE),
    Goals = sum(Goals, na.rm = TRUE),
    CE_Attempts = sum(CE_Attempts, na.rm = TRUE),
    CE_Success = sum(CE_Success, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) 

# Bind and Calculate Percentages
sgp_table_data <- bind_rows(full_stats, total_row) %>%
  mutate(
    `Shot Attempts` = as.numeric(Attempts),
    `Shooting (%)` = Goals / Attempts,
    `Circle Edge Feed Attempts` = as.numeric(CE_Attempts),
    `Circle Edge Feed Accuracy (%)` = CE_Success / CE_Attempts
  ) %>%
  select(Quarter,
         `Shot Attempts`,
         `Shooting (%)`,
         `Circle Edge Feed Attempts`,
         `Circle Edge Feed Accuracy (%)`) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Quarter, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = Value)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CONDITIONAL FORMATTING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
format_kpi <- function(val, is_percent = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(val) || !is.finite(val)) return("-")

  if (is_percent) {
    if (val >= 0.90) {
      color_bg <- "#57BB8A" # Green
    } else if (val >= 0.80) {
      color_bg <- "#F4B400" # Yellow/Orange
    } else {
      color_bg <- "#E67C73" # Red
    }
    txt <- paste0(round(val * 100), "%")
    cell_spec(txt, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

final_sgp_table <- sgp_table_data %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(across(c(Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Total), ~ {
    if (Metric %in% c("Shooting (%)", "Circle Edge Feed Accuracy (%)"))
      format_kpi(., TRUE)
    else
      format_kpi(., FALSE)
  })) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Metric = case_when(
      Metric == "Shooting (%)" ~ "Shooting (\\%)",
      Metric == "Circle Edge Feed Accuracy (%)" ~ "Circle Edge Feed Accuracy (\\%)",
      TRUE ~ Metric
    )
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RENDER TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
kable(final_sgp_table,
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE,
      caption = "Singapore Scoring \\& Feed Statistics (Overall)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# SINGAPORE PLAYER STATS (AGGREGATED)

```{r player_stats_summary}
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# 1. HELPER: KPI FORMATTING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
format_kpi <- function(val, is_percent = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(val) || !is.finite(val)) return("-")
  
  if (is_percent) {
    if (val >= 0.90) {
      color_bg <- "#57BB8A" # Green
    } else if (val >= 0.80) {
      color_bg <- "#F4B400" # Yellow/Orange
    } else {
      color_bg <- "#E67C73" # Red
    }
    
    # We use "%" here. cell_spec() handles the escaping for the cell VALUE automatically.
    txt <- paste0(round(val * 100), "%")
    
    cell_spec(txt, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

# 2. PREPARE AGGREGATED PLAYER METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
player_shooting <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(
    Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
    Attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

player_feeds <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Feed") %>%
  separate_rows(`Feed Location`, `Feed Success`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(Feeds = n(), .groups = "drop")

player_gains <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Gains") %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(Gains = n(), .groups = "drop")

player_turnovers <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Turnovers") %>%
  group_by(Player) %>%
  summarise(Turnovers = n(), .groups = "drop")

player_deflections <- data %>% 
  filter(Row == "SGP Deflection") %>% 
  separate_rows(Player, `Deflection Success`, sep = ",\\s*") %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Player, `Deflection Success`), str_trim)) %>% 
  group_by(Player) %>% 
  summarise(
    Deflections = n(),
    Deflections_to_Gain = sum(str_detect(`Deflection Success`, "Yes"), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. COMBINE ALL METRICS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
all_players <- unique(c(player_shooting$Player, player_feeds$Player, player_gains$Player, player_turnovers$Player))
all_players <- all_players[!is.na(all_players) & all_players != ""]

player_stats_combined <- tibble(Player = all_players) %>%
  left_join(player_shooting, by = "Player") %>%
  left_join(player_feeds, by = "Player") %>%
  left_join(player_gains, by = "Player") %>%
  left_join(player_turnovers, by = "Player") %>%
  left_join(player_deflections, by = "Player") %>%
  replace(is.na(.), 0) %>%
  
  # --- APPLY COLOR LOGIC ---
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Pct_Formatted = ifelse(Attempts > 0, 
                           format_kpi(Goals/Attempts, is_percent = TRUE), 
                           "-"),
    Defl_Pct = ifelse(Deflections > 0,
                     paste0(round(Deflections_to_Gain / Deflections * 100), "\\%"),
                     "-")
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # --- CRITICAL FIX IS HERE ---
  # We rename 'Shooting %' to 'Shooting \\%' so LaTeX prints the % symbol 
  # instead of treating it as a comment.
  select(Player, Goals, Attempts, `Shooting \\%` = Pct_Formatted, Feeds, Gains, Turnovers,
         Deflections, Defl_Pct) %>%
  arrange(desc(Goals), desc(Feeds))

# 4. RENDER TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

col_names_display <- c(
  "Player", "Goals", "Attempts", "Shot \\%",
  "Feeds", "Gains", "Turnovers", "Deflections", "Deflections \nto Gain \\%"
)

kable(player_stats_combined, 
      booktabs = TRUE,
      escape = FALSE, # Required for colors to show
      col.names = linebreak(col_names_display, align = "c"), 
      caption = "Aggregate Player Statistics (All Matches)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), full_width = FALSE) %>% # Removed striped
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# SINGAPORE SHOOTING

```{r sgp_shooting_summary}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 0. CONFIG & HELPER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Helper function (Same as used in player_stats_summary)
format_kpi <- function(val, is_percent = FALSE) {
  if (is.na(val) || !is.finite(val)) return("-")
  
  if (is_percent) {
    if (val >= 0.90) {
      color_bg <- "#57BB8A" # Green
    } else if (val >= 0.80) {
      color_bg <- "#F4B400" # Yellow/Orange
    } else {
      color_bg <- "#E67C73" # Red
    }
    
    # Use simple "%". cell_spec escapes it automatically.
    txt <- paste0(round(val * 100), "%")
    
    cell_spec(txt, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
  } else {
    as.character(round(val))
  }
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1A. OVERALL SHOOTING SUMMARY (Q1-Q4 Breakdown + Total)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
shooting_summary_long <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
  group_by(Quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), fill = list(Attempts = 0, Goals = 0))

# Calculate Total Row
total_shooting <- shooting_summary_long %>%
  summarise(
    Quarter = "Total",
    Attempts = sum(Attempts),
    Goals = sum(Goals)
  )

# Combine and Format
shooting_summary_final <- bind_rows(shooting_summary_long, total_shooting) %>%
  mutate(
    `Shooting %` = ifelse(Attempts > 0, Goals / Attempts, 0)
  ) %>%
  
  # --- APPLY COLOR LOGIC ---
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Attempts_Str = as.character(Attempts),
    Goals_Str = as.character(Goals),
    Pct_Formatted = format_kpi(`Shooting %`, is_percent = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Pivot to Wide
  select(Quarter, `Shot Attempts` = Attempts_Str, Goals = Goals_Str, `Shooting \\%` = Pct_Formatted) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Quarter, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = Value)

# Formatting for Display (Sorting Rows)
shooting_summary_display <- shooting_summary_final %>%
  mutate(Metric_Order = case_when(
    Metric == "Shot Attempts" ~ 1,
    Metric == "Goals" ~ 2,
    Metric == "Shooting \\%" ~ 3
  )) %>%
  arrange(Metric_Order) %>%
  select(-Metric_Order)

kable(shooting_summary_display, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE, # Required for colors
      caption = "Singapore Shooting Summary (Overall)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>% # Removed striped
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1B. PER MATCH SUMMARY (vs Opponents)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
per_match_summary <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
  group_by(Opponent) %>%
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Shooting %` = ifelse(Attempts > 0, Goals / Attempts, 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(match_order[Opponent]) %>% 
  
  # --- APPLY COLOR LOGIC ---
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Attempts_Str = as.character(Attempts),
    Goals_Str = as.character(Goals),
    Pct_Formatted = format_kpi(`Shooting %`, is_percent = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Pivot to Wide Format
  select(Opponent, `Shot Attempts` = Attempts_Str, Goals = Goals_Str, `Shooting \\%` = Pct_Formatted) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = -Opponent, names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Opponent, values_from = Value) %>%
  
  # Sorting Rows
  mutate(Metric_Order = case_when(
    Metric == "Shot Attempts" ~ 1,
    Metric == "Goals" ~ 2,
    Metric == "Shooting \\%" ~ 3
  )) %>%
  arrange(Metric_Order) %>%
  select(-Metric_Order)

kable(per_match_summary, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      caption = "Singapore Shooting Summary (Per Match)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>% # Removed striped
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. SHOOTING BY POSITION (GA/GS Breakdown - Transposed Layout)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# A. Prepare Data (Q1-Q4)
shooting_pos_qtr <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Shooter Position`) & `Shooter Position` != "") %>%
  group_by(Quarter, `Shooter Position`) %>%
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), `Shooter Position` = c("GA", "GS"), fill = list(Attempts = 0, Goals = 0))

# B. Calculate Totals
shooting_pos_total <- shooting_pos_qtr %>%
  group_by(`Shooter Position`) %>%
  summarise(
    Quarter = "Total",
    Attempts = sum(Attempts),
    Goals = sum(Goals),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# C. Bind and Calculate %
shooting_pos_combined <- bind_rows(shooting_pos_qtr, shooting_pos_total) %>%
  mutate(
    `Shooting %` = ifelse(Attempts > 0, Goals / Attempts, 0)
  )

# D. Format Values BEFORE Pivoting
formatted_long <- shooting_pos_combined %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Attempts_Str = as.character(Attempts),
    Goals_Str = as.character(Goals),
    Pct_Formatted = format_kpi(`Shooting %`, is_percent = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  # Rename columns to match desired row names (including escaped %)
  select(Quarter, `Shooter Position`, `Shot Attempts` = Attempts_Str, Goals = Goals_Str, `Shooting \\%` = Pct_Formatted) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(`Shot Attempts`, Goals, `Shooting \\%`), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value")

# E. Pivot to Wide Format
# Columns will become: GA_Q1, GA_Q2... GS_Total
pos_wide <- formatted_long %>%
  unite("Pos_Qtr", `Shooter Position`, Quarter, sep = "_") %>%
  select(Metric, Pos_Qtr, Value) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Pos_Qtr, values_from = Value)

# F. Clean Up Rows (Ordering)
pos_final <- pos_wide %>%
  mutate(
    Metric_Order = case_when(
      Metric == "Shot Attempts" ~ 1,
      Metric == "Goals" ~ 2,
      Metric == "Shooting \\%" ~ 3,
      TRUE ~ 4
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(Metric_Order) %>%
  select(-Metric_Order)

# G. Select Columns in Specific Order (GA first, then GS)
desired_order <- c("Metric", 
                   "GA_Q1", "GA_Q2", "GA_Q3", "GA_Q4", "GA_Total",
                   "GS_Q1", "GS_Q2", "GS_Q3", "GS_Q4", "GS_Total")

# Filter to only keep columns that actually exist (safe selection)
existing_cols <- intersect(desired_order, names(pos_final))
pos_final <- pos_final %>% select(all_of(existing_cols))

# H. Render Table
kable(pos_final, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Metric", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total"),
      caption = "Shooting Performance by Position (Overall)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), full_width = FALSE) %>% # Removed striped
  # Add the spanning headers: 1 blank for Metric, 5 for GA, 5 for GS
  add_header_above(c(" " = 1, "Goal Attack (GA)" = 5, "Goal Shooter (GS)" = 5), bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>% 
  column_spec(c(6, 11), bold = TRUE, border_left = TRUE) %>% # Bold/Border the Total columns
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. SHOOTING HEATMAP VISUALIZATION (Flipped: Curve at Bottom)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- A. GEOMETRY HELPERS ---
# Using x=r*sin(theta), y=r*cos(theta)
arc_points <- function(r, start, end, n = 50) {
  tibble(
    theta = seq(start, end, length.out = n),
    x = r * sin(theta),  
    y = r * cos(theta)   
  )
}

# Generate Bottom Semi-Circle Arcs (pi/2 to 3pi/2)
circle_df <- function(r, n = 200) {
  tibble(
    angle = seq(pi/2, 3*pi/2, length.out = n),
    x = r * sin(angle),
    y = r * cos(angle)
  )
}

# --- B. DEFINE ZONES (Bottom Half Orientation) ---
# Right Zone: pi/2 to 5pi/6 (90 to 150 deg) -> Positive X
# Middle Zone: 5pi/6 to 7pi/6 (150 to 210 deg) -> Centered on South
# Left Zone: 7pi/6 to 3pi/2 (210 to 270 deg) -> Negative X

wedge_polys <- bind_rows(
  # Inner Middle
  { inner <- arc_points(0, 5*pi/6, 7*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 7*pi/6, 5*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Middle") },
  # Outer Middle
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, 5*pi/6, 7*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 7*pi/6, 5*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Middle") },
  
  # Inner Right (True Right side of plot)
  { inner <- arc_points(0, pi/2, 5*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 5*pi/6, pi/2); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Right") },
  # Outer Right (True Right side of plot)
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, pi/2, 5*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 5*pi/6, pi/2); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Right") },
  
  # Inner Left (True Left side of plot)
  { inner <- arc_points(0, 7*pi/6, 3*pi/2); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 3*pi/2, 7*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Left") },
  # Outer Left (True Left side of plot)
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, 7*pi/6, 3*pi/2); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 3*pi/2, 7*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Left") }
)

# --- C. PREPARE DATA ---
zone_agg <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
  separate_rows(`Shot Location`, sep = ",\\s*") %>% 
  mutate(`Shot Location` = str_trim(`Shot Location`)) %>%
  filter(`Shot Location` %in% c("Inner Middle", "Outer Middle", 
                                "Inner Left", "Outer Left", 
                                "Inner Right", "Outer Right")) %>%
  rename(shot_area = `Shot Location`) %>%
  group_by(shot_area) %>%
  summarise(
    Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
    Attempts = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(pct = Goals / Attempts) %>%
  # --- 3-TIER LOGIC CATEGORIZATION ---
  mutate(
    KPI_Tier = case_when(
      pct >= 0.90 ~ ">= 90%",
      pct >= 0.80 ~ "80% - 89%",
      TRUE        ~ "< 80%"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(KPI_Tier = factor(KPI_Tier, levels = c(">= 90%", "80% - 89%", "< 80%")))

# --- D. JOIN DATA TO GEOMETRY ---
zone_heat <- zone_agg %>%
  right_join(wedge_polys, by = "shot_area")

# --- E. CREATE LABEL DATA SEPARATELY ---
label_data <- zone_heat %>%
  group_by(shot_area) %>%
  summarise(
    cx = mean(x),
    cy = mean(y),
    pct = first(pct),
    goals = first(Goals),
    attempts = first(Attempts)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(pct)) %>%
  # REMOVED FILTER: Now showing labels for ALL zones (Inner + Outer)
  mutate(
    label_text = paste0(scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1), "\n(", goals, "/", attempts, ")")
  )

# --- F. PLOT ---
ggplot() +
  # Goal circle outlines
  geom_path(data = circle_df(4.9), aes(x, y), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_path(data = circle_df(3.0), aes(x, y), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
  
  # Filled wedges
  geom_polygon(
    data = zone_heat,
    aes(x = x, y = y, group = shot_area, fill = KPI_Tier),
    colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5
  ) +
  
  # Labels
  geom_text(
    data = label_data,
    aes(x = cx, y = cy, label = label_text),
    fontface = "bold", color = "black", size = 3.5
  ) +
  
  # Scales and Theme
  # Y-limit changed to negative to show bottom half
  coord_fixed(ylim = c(-5.2, 0), xlim = c(-5, 5)) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      ">= 90%"      = "#57BB8A",  # Green
      "80% - 89%"   = "#F4B400",  # Yellow
      "< 80%"       = "#E67C73"   # Red
    ),
    na.value = "#DDDDDD",       
    name = "Accuracy"
  ) +
  
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  ) +
  labs(title = "Shooting Accuracy by Zone (Overall)")
```

```{r sgp_player_shooting_heatmap, fig.height=6.5, fig.width=6.5}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 7. PLAYER SHOOTING HEATMAPS (Flipped: Curve at Bottom)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- A. DEFINE SEARCH PATTERNS ---
shooter_patterns <- c("Amandeep", "Kai Wei", "Pei Shan", "Wei Ping", 
                      "Sara", "Charlotte", "Zulfa")

# --- B. GEOMETRY HELPERS ---
arc_points <- function(r, start, end, n = 50) {
  tibble(
    theta = seq(start, end, length.out = n),
    x = r * sin(theta),  
    y = r * cos(theta)   
  )
}

circle_df <- function(r, n = 200) {
  tibble(
    angle = seq(pi/2, 3*pi/2, length.out = n),
    x = r * sin(angle),
    y = r * cos(angle)
  )
}

# --- C. DEFINE ZONES (Bottom Half Orientation) ---
wedge_polys <- bind_rows(
  { inner <- arc_points(0, 5*pi/6, 7*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 7*pi/6, 5*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Middle") },
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, 5*pi/6, 7*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 7*pi/6, 5*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Middle") },
  { inner <- arc_points(0, pi/2, 5*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 5*pi/6, pi/2); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Right") },
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, pi/2, 5*pi/6); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 5*pi/6, pi/2); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Right") },
  { inner <- arc_points(0, 7*pi/6, 3*pi/2); outer <- arc_points(3.0, 3*pi/2, 7*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Inner Left") },
  { inner <- arc_points(3.0, 7*pi/6, 3*pi/2); outer <- arc_points(4.9, 3*pi/2, 7*pi/6); bind_rows(inner, outer) %>% mutate(shot_area = "Outer Left") }
)

# --- D. FUNCTION TO GENERATE PLOT FOR SINGLE PLAYER ---
generate_player_plot <- function(player_pattern) {
  
  # 1. Filter Data for specific player
  player_data <- data %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>%
    separate_rows(`Shot Outcome`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    mutate(`Shot Outcome` = str_trim(`Shot Outcome`)) %>%
    separate_rows(`Shot Location`, sep = ",\\s*") %>% 
    mutate(`Shot Location` = str_trim(`Shot Location`)) %>%
    filter(str_detect(Player, player_pattern)) %>%
    filter(`Shot Location` %in% c("Inner Middle", "Outer Middle", 
                                  "Inner Left", "Outer Left", 
                                  "Inner Right", "Outer Right"))
  
  # Return NULL if no shots for this player
  if(nrow(player_data) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # Continue with data processing
  player_data <- player_data %>%
    rename(shot_area = `Shot Location`) %>%
    group_by(shot_area) %>%
    summarise(
      Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"), na.rm = TRUE),
      Attempts = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(pct = Goals / Attempts) %>%
    mutate(
      KPI_Tier = case_when(
        pct >= 0.90 ~ ">= 90%",
        pct >= 0.80 ~ "80% - 89%",
        TRUE        ~ "< 80%"
      )
    ) %>%
    mutate(KPI_Tier = factor(KPI_Tier, levels = c(">= 90%", "80% - 89%", "< 80%")))

  # Calculate overall stats
  total_goals <- sum(player_data$Goals)
  total_attempts <- sum(player_data$Attempts)
  overall_pct <- ifelse(total_attempts > 0, total_goals / total_attempts, 0)
  
  subtitle_text <- paste0("Overall: ", total_goals, "/", total_attempts, " (", round(overall_pct * 100), "%)")

  # Join with Geometry
  plot_data <- player_data %>%
    right_join(wedge_polys, by = "shot_area")

  # Create Labels
  label_data <- plot_data %>%
    group_by(shot_area) %>%
    summarise(
      cx = mean(x),
      cy = mean(y),
      pct = first(pct),
      goals = first(Goals),
      attempts = first(Attempts)
    ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(attempts) & attempts > 0) %>% 
    mutate(
      label_text = paste0(scales::percent(pct, accuracy = 1), "\n(", goals, "/", attempts, ")")
    )
    
  # Get Full Player Name for Title
  full_name <- data %>% 
    filter(str_detect(Player, player_pattern)) %>% 
    slice(1) %>% pull(Player)
  
  if(length(full_name) == 0) full_name <- player_pattern

  # Create Plot
  p <- ggplot() +
    geom_path(data = circle_df(4.9), aes(x, y), colour = "grey40", linewidth = 1) +
    geom_path(data = circle_df(3.0), aes(x, y), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    geom_polygon(
      data = plot_data,
      aes(x = x, y = y, group = shot_area, fill = KPI_Tier),
      colour = "white", linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_text(
      data = label_data,
      aes(x = cx, y = cy, label = label_text),
      fontface = "bold", color = "black", size = 2.8 
    ) +
    coord_fixed(ylim = c(-5.2, 0), xlim = c(-5, 5)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(">= 90%" = "#57BB8A", "80% - 89%" = "#F4B400", "< 80%" = "#E67C73"),
      na.value = "#DDDDDD", drop = FALSE, name = "Accuracy"
    ) +
    theme_void() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none", 
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 11),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold", color = "grey30"),
      plot.margin = margin(t = 0, r = 10, b = 10, l = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = full_name,
      subtitle = subtitle_text
    )
    
  return(p)
}

# --- E. GENERATE PLOTS ---
plot_list <<- map(shooter_patterns, generate_player_plot) %>% compact()

# --- F. DISPLAY FIRST 4 PLOTS ---
if(length(plot_list) > 0) {
  first_four <- plot_list[1:min(4, length(plot_list))]
  grid.arrange(grobs = first_four, ncol = 2)
} else {
  cat("No shooting data available for any players.")
}
```

# SGP FEEDS SUMMARY

KPI Summary: At least 90% accuracy for Circle Edge

```{r sgp_feeds_summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. HELPER FUNCTION: 3-TIER FORMATTING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
format_kpi_cell <- function(val, text_label) {
  # Round to integer for logic consistency
  pct_int <- round(val * 100)
  
  # 3-Tier Color Logic
  color_bg <- ifelse(pct_int >= 90, "#57BB8A",        # Green (KPI Met)
               ifelse(pct_int >= 80, "#F4B400",       # Yellow
                                    "#E67C73"))       # Red
                                    
  # cell_spec escapes special chars (like %) by default, which is what we want here
  cell_spec(text_label, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
}

# 2. DATA PREPARATION
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Filter for SGP Feeds and expand rows
feeds_clean <- data %>%
  filter(str_detect(Row, "SGP Feed")) %>%
  separate_rows(`Feed Location`, `Feed Success`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(across(c(`Feed Location`, `Feed Success`), str_trim)) %>%
  filter(`Feed Location` %in% c("Circle Edge", "Inside Circle", "Outside Circle"))

# 3. CALCULATE METRICS (OVERALL TABLE)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
feed_stats <- feeds_clean %>%
  group_by(`Feed Location`, Quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Successes = sum(`Feed Success` == "YES", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  complete(
    `Feed Location` = c("Circle Edge", "Inside Circle", "Outside Circle"), 
    Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), 
    fill = list(Attempts = 0, Successes = 0)
  )

# Calculate Totals
feed_totals <- feed_stats %>%
  group_by(`Feed Location`) %>%
  summarise(
    Quarter = "Total",
    Attempts = sum(Attempts),
    Successes = sum(Successes),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Combine and Format
final_feed_table <- bind_rows(feed_stats, feed_totals) %>%
  mutate(
    Pct = ifelse(Attempts > 0, Successes / Attempts, 0),
    Count_Str = as.character(Successes),
    
    # --- CONDITIONAL FORMATTING LOGIC ---
    Acc_Str = case_when(
      Attempts == 0 ~ "-",
      # Only apply color if Location is "Circle Edge"
      `Feed Location` == "Circle Edge" ~ format_kpi_cell(Pct, paste0(round(Pct * 100), "%")),
      # Otherwise, return plain text (escaped manually for LaTeX because it skips cell_spec)
      TRUE ~ paste0(round(Pct * 100), "\\%")
    )
  ) %>%
  select(`Feed Location`, Quarter, Count_Str, Acc_Str) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Quarter,
    values_from = c(Count_Str, Acc_Str),
    names_glue = "{Quarter}_{.value}"
  ) %>%
  select(

    Total_Count_Str, Total_Acc_Str
  ) %>%

  arrange(`Feed Location`)

)

  column_spec(11, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 5. TABLE 2: CIRCLE EDGE FEEDS BY MATCH (ORDERED & COLORED)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
ce_feeds_by_match <- feeds_clean %>%
  filter(`Feed Location` == "Circle Edge") %>%
  group_by(Opponent) %>%
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Successes = sum(`Feed Success` == "YES", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Accuracy = ifelse(Attempts > 0, Successes / Attempts, 0)
  ) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    Accuracy_Fmt = format_kpi_cell(Accuracy, paste0(round(Accuracy * 100), "%"))
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(
    Match = Opponent,
    Attempts,
    `Successful Feeds` = Successes,
    `Accuracy (\\%)` = Accuracy_Fmt
  ) %>%
  arrange(match_order[Match])

kable(
  ce_feeds_by_match,
  booktabs = TRUE,
  escape = FALSE,
  caption = "Circle Edge Feeds by Match"
) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# CENTRE PASS ATTACK SUMMARY

KPI Summary

- CPA: At least 80% conversion rate

- DCPA: At least 75% conversion rate

```{r cpa_summary, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. HELPER FUNCTION: QUARTERLY BREAKDOWN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_cp_metrics <- function(df, row_filter, goal_keyword, prefix, 
                            use_color = TRUE, include_attempts = FALSE) {
  threshold <- ifelse(prefix == "DCPA", 0.75, 0.80)

  df %>%
    filter(Row == row_filter) %>%
    group_by(Quarter) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Possessions = n(),
      Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, goal_keyword), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), fill = list(Total_Possessions = 0, Goals = 0)) %>%
    bind_rows(summarise(., Quarter = "Total", Total_Possessions = sum(Total_Possessions), Goals = sum(Goals))) %>%
    mutate(
      CP_Attempts = as.character(Total_Possessions),
      Pct = ifelse(Total_Possessions > 0, Goals / Total_Possessions, 0),
      Goals_Str = as.character(Goals),
      Acc_Str = if (use_color) {
        ifelse(
          Total_Possessions == 0, "-",
          {
            color_bg <- ifelse(Pct >= threshold, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
            cell_spec(paste0(round(Pct * 100), "%"), "latex", 
                      color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
          }
        )
      } else {
        ifelse(Total_Possessions == 0, "-", paste0(round(Pct * 100), "\\%"))
      }
    ) %>%
    select(Quarter,CP_Attempts, Goals_Str, Acc_Str) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CP_Attempts, Goals_Str, Acc_Str), names_to = "Type", 
                 values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = case_when(
        Type == "CP_Attempts" ~ "CP Attempts",
        Type == "Goals_Str" ~ paste(prefix, "Goals"),
        Type == "Acc_Str" ~ paste(prefix, "Conversion \\%")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(include_attempts | Type != "CP_Attempts") %>%
    select(Quarter, Metric, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = Value)
}

# 2. HELPER FUNCTION: MATCH BREAKDOWN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_cp_match_metrics <- function(df, row_filter, goal_keyword, prefix, 
                                  include_attempts = FALSE) {
  threshold <- ifelse(prefix == "DCPA", 0.75, 0.80)

  df %>%
    filter(Row == row_filter) %>%
    group_by(Opponent) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Possessions = n(),
      Goals = sum(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, goal_keyword), na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(match_order[Opponent]) %>% 
    mutate(Opponent = factor(Opponent, levels = Opponent)) %>% 
    mutate(
      CP_Attempts = as.character(Total_Possessions),
      Pct = ifelse(Total_Possessions > 0, Goals / Total_Possessions, 0),
      Goals_Str = as.character(Goals),
      Acc_Str = ifelse(
        Total_Possessions == 0, "-",
        {
          color_bg <- ifelse(Pct >= threshold, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
          cell_spec(paste0(round(Pct * 100), "%"), "latex", 
                    color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
        }
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Opponent, CP_Attempts, Goals_Str, Acc_Str) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(CP_Attempts, Goals_Str, Acc_Str),
                 names_to = "Type", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = case_when(
        Type == "CP_Attempts" ~ "CP Attempts",
        Type == "Goals_Str" ~ paste(prefix, "Goals"),
        Type == "Acc_Str" ~ paste(prefix, "Conversion \\%")
      )
    ) %>%
    filter(include_attempts | Type != "CP_Attempts") %>%
    select(Opponent, Metric, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Opponent, values_from = Value)
}

# 3. GENERATE TABLES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Table 1: Quarterly Summary
sgp_cpa  <- calc_cp_metrics(data, "SGP CPA",  "SGP Goal", "CPA", use_color = TRUE,
                            include_attempts = TRUE)
sgp_dcpa <- calc_cp_metrics(data, "SGP DCPA", "SGP Goal", "DCPA", use_color = TRUE)
final_cpa_table <- bind_rows(sgp_cpa, sgp_dcpa)

# Table 2: Match Summary
sgp_cpa_match  <- calc_cp_match_metrics(data, "SGP CPA",  "SGP Goal", "CPA",
                                        include_attempts = TRUE)
sgp_dcpa_match <- calc_cp_match_metrics(data, "SGP DCPA", "SGP Goal", "DCPA")

final_match_table <- bind_rows(sgp_cpa_match, sgp_dcpa_match)
  

# 4. RENDER TABLES
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kable(final_cpa_table, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Metric", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total"),
      caption = "Centre Pass Attack Summary (Overall)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
  pack_rows(meta_team_name, 1, 5) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "5cm") %>%
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)

kable(final_match_table, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      caption = "Centre Pass Attack Summary (Per Match)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
  pack_rows(meta_team_name, 1, 5) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:ncol(final_match_table), width = "2cm", 
              latex_valign = "m") %>%
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

# SGP CENTRE PASS ATTACKING TENDENCIES

```{r cpa_tendencies, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.align='center'}

# 1. DEFINE MAPS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
map_phase1 <- tribble(
  ~Location,               ~x, ~y, ~Label,
  "Center Left Attack",     1,  2, "C Left (A)",
  "Center Mid Attack",      2,  2, "C Mid (A)",
  "Center Right Attack",    3,  2, "C Right (A)",
  "Center Left Defense",    1,  1, "C Left (D)",
  "Center Mid Defense",     2,  1, "C Mid (D)",
  "Center Right Defense",   3,  1, "C Right (D)"
)

map_phase2 <- tribble(
  ~Location,               ~x, ~y, ~Label,
  "Center Left Attack",     1,  2, "C Left (A)",
  "Center Mid Attack",      2,  2, "C Mid (A)",
  "Center Right Attack",    3,  2, "C Right (A)",
  "Center Left Defense",    1,  1, "C Left (D)",
  "Center Mid Defense",     2,  1, "C Mid (D)",
  "Center Right Defense",   3,  1, "C Right (D)",
  "Attacking Left",         1,  3, "Att Left",
  "Attacking Middle",       2,  3, "Att Mid",
  "Attacking Right",        3,  3, "Att Right",
  "Attacking Left Pocket",  1,  4, "AL Pocket",
  "Attacking D",            2,  4, "Att Circle",
  "Attacking Right Pocket", 3,  4, "AR Pocket"
)

# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

find_col <- function(df, pattern) {
  match <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if(length(match) > 0) return(match[1]) 
  return(NULL) 
}

get_loc_counts <- function(df, pass_pattern, map_df) {
  target_col <- find_col(df, pass_pattern)
  
  if (is.null(target_col)) {
    return(map_df %>% mutate(Count = 0))
  }
  
  df %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP CPA") %>%
    separate_rows(!!sym(target_col), sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    mutate(Location = str_trim(!!sym(target_col))) %>%
    filter(Location %in% map_df$Location) %>%
    group_by(Location) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    right_join(map_df, by = "Location") %>%
    replace_na(list(Count = 0))
}

get_receiver_stats <- function(df, pass_pattern, recv_pattern, target_recvs) {
  pass_col <- find_col(df, pass_pattern)
  recv_col <- find_col(df, recv_pattern)
  
  if (is.null(recv_col)) {
    return(tibble(Receiver = target_recvs, Count = 0))
  }

  stats <- df %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP CPA") %>%
    select(Receiver_Raw = !!sym(recv_col)) %>%
    separate_rows(Receiver_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    mutate(Receiver = str_trim(Receiver_Raw)) %>%
    mutate(Receiver = ifelse(is.na(Receiver) | Receiver == "", "Not taken", Receiver)) %>%
    group_by(Receiver) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  tibble(Receiver = target_recvs) %>%
    left_join(stats, by = "Receiver") %>%
    replace_na(list(Count = 0))
}

# Function to Draw Heatmap (Green Theme)
draw_cpa_heatmap <- function(plot_data, title_text) {
  
  plot_data_ranked <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(
      Rank = dense_rank(desc(Count)),
      Highlight = case_when(
        Count == 0 ~ "Other", 
        Rank == 1 ~ "Rank1",
        Rank == 2 ~ "Rank2",
        Rank == 3 ~ "Rank3",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      ),
      Highlight = factor(Highlight, levels = c("Rank1", "Rank2", "Rank3", "Other"))
    )

  # Green Palette
  highlight_colors <- c(
    "Rank1" = "#005a32",   # Kelly Green
    "Rank2" = "#41ab5d",   # Grass Green
    "Rank3" = "#addd8e",   # Pale Green
    "Other" = "#e6f8d9"    # Very Light Green
  )

  ggplot(plot_data_ranked, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Highlight)) +
    geom_tile(color = "black", size = 0.5) +
    
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Count > 0, Count, ""), 
                  color = Highlight == "Rank1" | Highlight == "Rank2"), 
              fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    
    scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "black", "TRUE" = "white"), guide = "none") +
    

    geom_text(aes(label = Label,
                  color = Highlight %in% c("Rank1", "Rank2")), 
              size = 3, vjust = 2.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = highlight_colors) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = title_text) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", margin = margin(b=10)),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Function to Draw Table (TOTAL ROW REMOVED)
draw_cpa_table <- function(table_data) {
  # No bind_rows here anymore
  
  tt <- ttheme_minimal(
    core = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.1)),
    colhead = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.1, fontface = "bold"))
  )
  tableGrob(table_data, rows = NULL, theme = tt)
}

# 3. PREPARE DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
data_p1_loc <- get_loc_counts(data, "1st.*Pass", map_phase1)
targets_p1 <- c("GA", "WA", "GD", "WD", "Not Taken")
data_p1_recv <- get_receiver_stats(data, "1st.*Pass", "1st.*Receiver", targets_p1)

data_p2_loc <- get_loc_counts(data, "2nd.*Pass", map_phase2)
targets_p2 <- c("GS", "GA", "WA", "C", "WD", "GD", "GK", "Not Taken")
data_p2_recv <- get_receiver_stats(data, "2nd.*Pass", "2nd.*Receiver", targets_p2)

# 4. GENERATE PLOTS & RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
plot_p1 <- draw_cpa_heatmap(data_p1_loc, "1st Phase Distribution")
tbl_p1  <- draw_cpa_table(data_p1_recv)

plot_p2 <- draw_cpa_heatmap(data_p2_loc, "2nd Phase Distribution")
tbl_p2  <- draw_cpa_table(data_p2_recv)

grid.arrange(plot_p1, tbl_p1, ncol = 2, widths = c(1.5, 1))
grid.arrange(plot_p2, tbl_p2, ncol = 2, widths = c(1.5, 1))
```

```{r cpa_combo_ranking, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. HELPER FUNCTION (Reuse robust column finder)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
find_col <- function(df, pattern) {
  match <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if(length(match) > 0) return(match[1]) 
  return(NULL) 
}

# 2. PROCESS DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify dynamic column names
col_recv1 <- find_col(data, "1st.*Receiver")
col_recv2 <- find_col(data, "2nd.*Receiver")

if (!is.null(col_recv1) & !is.null(col_recv2)) {
  
  cpa_combos <- data %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP CPA") %>%
    # Select only relevant columns
    select(Recv1_Raw = !!sym(col_recv1), Recv2_Raw = !!sym(col_recv2)) %>%
    
    # Robustness: Handle comma-separated values (Expand rows)
    separate_rows(Recv1_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    separate_rows(Recv2_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    
    # Clean text
    mutate(
      Recv1 = str_trim(Recv1_Raw),
      Recv2 = str_trim(Recv2_Raw)
    ) %>%
    
    # Filter out empty/missing data to focus on valid combos
    filter(Recv1 != "", !is.na(Recv1)) %>%
    filter(Recv2 != "", !is.na(Recv2)) %>%
    
    # Create Combination String
    mutate(Combination = paste(Recv1, "-", Recv2)) %>%
    
    # Count frequencies
    count(Combination, name = "Frequency") %>%
    
    # Rank and Top 3
    arrange(desc(Frequency)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3) # Strict top 3 (use slice_max(n=3) if you want to include ties)

} else {
  # Fallback if columns missing
  cpa_combos <- tibble(Combination = "No Data Found", Frequency = 0)
}

# 3. RENDER TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
kable(cpa_combos, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      col.names = c("Position Combination (1st - 2nd)", "Frequency"),
      caption = "Top 3 CPA Position Combinations",
      align = c("l", "c")) %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position")) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "6cm") %>%
  column_spec(2, width = "3cm")
```

```{r cpa_pass_combo_ranked, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.align='center',  fig.width=6, fig.height=7}
# 1. Prepare the data
pass_combination_plot <- data %>%
  filter(Row == "SGP CPA") %>%
  select(
    Pass1_Raw = `1st Phase Pass`, 
    Pass2_Raw = `2nd Phase Pass`
  ) %>%
  separate_rows(Pass1_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  separate_rows(Pass2_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(
    Pass1 = str_trim(Pass1_Raw),
    Pass2 = str_trim(Pass2_Raw)
  ) %>%
  filter(Pass1 != "" & !is.na(Pass1)) %>%
  filter(Pass2 != "" & !is.na(Pass2)) %>%
  
  # Create path string
  mutate(pass_path = paste(Pass1, "->", Pass2)) %>%
  
  # Count the frequency of each path
  count(pass_path, name = "count") %>%
  
  # Filter for the top 10 most frequent paths
  slice_max(count, n = 10) %>%
  
  # 1. Wrap text labels so they don't run off the page
  mutate(pass_path = str_wrap(pass_path, width = 25)) %>%
  
  # 2. Rank the data so the highest frequency is at the top
  mutate(pass_path = fct_reorder(pass_path, count)) %>%

  # 3. Create the Plot
  ggplot(aes(x = count, y = pass_path)) +
  
  # Use a single static color since we aren't tracking success anymore
  geom_col(fill = "#41ab5d") +
  
  # Add labels "on top" (to the right) of the bars
  geom_text(aes(label = count), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5, color = "black") +
  
  # Add extra space on the right (x-axis) so labels don't get cut off
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  
  # Formatting
  labs(
    title = "Top 10 CPA Pass Combinations",
    subtitle = "Ranked by frequency (Phase 1 -> Phase 2)",
    x = "Frequency",
    y = "" 
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# Display the plot
print(pass_combination_plot)
```

```{r opponent_cpa_tendencies, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=8, fig.height=4, fig.align='center'}
# 2. HELPER FUNCTIONS

# --- UPDATED FUNCTION (Same logic as SGP Fix) ---
get_receiver_stats <- function(df, pass_pattern, recv_pattern, target_recvs) {
  pass_col <- find_col(df, pass_pattern)
  recv_col <- find_col(df, recv_pattern)
  
  if (is.null(recv_col)) {
    return(tibble(Receiver = target_recvs, Count = 0))
  }

  stats <- df %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP CPD") %>% # Updated Row for Opposition
    select(Receiver_Raw = !!sym(recv_col)) %>%
    separate_rows(Receiver_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    mutate(Receiver = str_trim(Receiver_Raw)) %>%
    
    # --- LOGIC FIX: Filter out Empty/NA cells first ---
    # This prevents rows with NO 2nd phase from being counted as "Not Taken"
    filter(!is.na(Receiver) & Receiver != "") %>%
    
    # Standardize "Not Taken" case
    mutate(

        str_to_lower(Receiver) == "not taken" ~ "Not Taken",
        TRUE ~ Receiver
      )
    ) %>%
    # --------------------------------------------------
    
    group_by(Receiver) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  tibble(Receiver = target_recvs) %>%
    left_join(stats, by = "Receiver") %>%
    replace_na(list(Count = 0))
}

# Function to Draw Table
draw_cpa_table <- function(table_data) {
  # --- MODIFICATION: REMOVED THE "TOTAL" ROW LOGIC ---
  # Previously: table_data <- table_data %>% bind_rows(tibble(Receiver = "Total", ...))
  # Now: We simply pass the table_data as is (Receiver breakdown only)
  
  tt <- ttheme_minimal(
    core = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.1)),
    colhead = list(fg_params = list(hjust = 0, x = 0.1, fontface = "bold"))
  )
  tableGrob(table_data, rows = NULL, theme = tt)
}

# 3. PREPARE DATA

data_p1_loc <- get_loc_counts(data, "1st.*Pass", map_phase1)

# UPDATE: Changed "Not taken" to "Not Taken" (Capital T) to match CSV

data_p1_recv <- get_receiver_stats(data, "1st.*Pass", "1st.*Receiver", targets_p1)

# 4. GENERATE PLOTS & RENDER
```

```{r opp_cpa_combo_ranking}
find_col <- function(df, pattern) {
  match <- names(df)[str_detect(names(df), regex(pattern, ignore_case = TRUE))]
  if(length(match) > 0) return(match[1]) 
  return(NULL) 
}

# 2. PROCESS DATA (OPPOSITION)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Identify dynamic column names
col_recv1 <- find_col(data, "1st.*Receiver")
col_recv2 <- find_col(data, "2nd.*Receiver")

if (!is.null(col_recv1) & !is.null(col_recv2)) {
  
  opp_cpa_combos <- data %>%
    filter(Row == "SGP CPD") %>% # Filter for Opposition CPA
    select(Recv1_Raw = !!sym(col_recv1), Recv2_Raw = !!sym(col_recv2)) %>%
    
    separate_rows(Recv1_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    separate_rows(Recv2_Raw, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    
    mutate(
      Recv1 = str_trim(Recv1_Raw),
      Recv2 = str_trim(Recv2_Raw)
    ) %>%
    
    filter(Recv1 != "", !is.na(Recv1)) %>%
    filter(Recv2 != "", !is.na(Recv2)) %>%
    
    mutate(Combination = paste(Recv1, "->", Recv2)) %>%
    count(Combination, name = "Frequency") %>%
    arrange(desc(Frequency)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 3)
  
} else {
  opp_cpa_combos <- tibble(Combination = "No Data Found", Frequency = 0)
}

# 3. RENDER TABLE

      booktabs = TRUE,
```

# SGP GAINS & TURNOVERS

KPI Summary

- Gains: At least 6 per quarter (24 per game) and 75%+ conversion

- Turnovers: No more than 5 per quarter (20 per game)

```{r sgp_gains_turnovers, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. HELPER FUNCTION: QUARTERLY BREAKDOWN
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_gn_to_table <- function(df) {
  
  # --- TARGETS ---
  target_gains_cnt_q  <- comp_kpi_gains_qtr    # Green if Gains >= 6 per quarter per game
  target_gains_cnt_t  <- comp_kpi_gains   # Green if Gains >= 24 per game
  target_gains_conv   <- 0.75 # Green if Gains Conversion >= 75%
  
  target_to_cnt_q     <- comp_kpi_to_qtr    # Green if Turnovers <= 5 per quarter per game
  target_to_cnt_t     <- comp_kpi_to   # Green if Turnovers <= 20 total per game
  # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

  # A. CALCULATE RAW STATS
  stats_q <- df %>%
    filter(Row %in% c("SGP Gains", "SGP Turnovers")) %>%
    group_by(Quarter, Row) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      Success_Gain = sum(Row == "SGP Gains" & str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "SGP Goal"), na.rm=TRUE),
      Concede_TO   = sum(Row == "SGP Turnovers" & str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "OPP Goal"), na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    complete(Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), Row = c("SGP Gains", "SGP Turnovers"), 
             fill = list(Count = 0, Success_Gain = 0, Concede_TO = 0))

  # B. CALCULATE TOTALS
  stats_total <- stats_q %>%
    group_by(Row) %>%
    summarise(
      Quarter = "Total",
      Count = sum(Count),
      Success_Gain = sum(Success_Gain),
      Concede_TO = sum(Concede_TO),
      .groups = "drop"
    )

  # C. COMBINE, CLEAN NAMES, & PIVOT
  bind_rows(stats_q, stats_total) %>%
    mutate(Row = str_replace_all(Row, " ", "_")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Row, values_from = c(Count, Success_Gain, Concede_TO)) %>%
    mutate(
      Metric_Gains = Count_SGP_Gains,
      Metric_Gains_Conv = ifelse(Count_SGP_Gains > 0, Success_Gain_SGP_Gains / Count_SGP_Gains, 0),
      Metric_TO = Count_SGP_Turnovers,
      Metric_TO_Concede = ifelse(Count_SGP_Turnovers > 0, Concede_TO_SGP_Turnovers / Count_SGP_Turnovers, 0),
      Metric_Diff = Metric_Gains - Metric_TO
    ) %>%
    
    # D. FORMATTING
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      Display_Gains = {
        threshold <- ifelse(Quarter == "Total", target_gains_cnt_t, target_gains_cnt_q)
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_Gains >= threshold, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_Gains), "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_Gains_Conv = {
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_Gains_Conv >= target_gains_conv, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        val_str <- paste0(round(Metric_Gains_Conv * 100), "%") 
        if(Count_SGP_Gains == 0) "-" else cell_spec(val_str, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_TO = {
        threshold <- ifelse(Quarter == "Total", target_to_cnt_t, target_to_cnt_q)
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_TO <= threshold, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_TO), "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_TO_Concede = {
        val_str <- paste0(round(Metric_TO_Concede * 100), "\\%")
        if(Count_SGP_Turnovers == 0) "-" else val_str
      },
      Display_Diff = {
        color_bg <- case_when(
          Metric_Diff > 0 ~ "#57BB8A", # Green
          Metric_Diff < 0 ~ "#E67C73", # Red
          TRUE            ~ "white"    # Zero
        )
        color_text <- ifelse(Metric_Diff == 0, "black", "white")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_Diff), "latex", color = color_text, bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Quarter, Display_Gains, Display_Gains_Conv, Display_TO, Display_TO_Concede, Display_Diff) %>%
    
    # Pivot to Final Shape
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Display"), names_to = "Metric_Code", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = case_when(
        Metric_Code == "Display_Gains" ~ "Gains",
        Metric_Code == "Display_Gains_Conv" ~ "Gains Conversion \\%",
        Metric_Code == "Display_TO" ~ "Turnovers",
        Metric_Code == "Display_TO_Concede" ~ "Turnovers to Concede \\%",
        Metric_Code == "Display_Diff" ~ "Gains to Turnover Differential"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Quarter, Metric, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = Value) %>%
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c(
      "Gains", "Gains Conversion \\%", "Turnovers", "Turnovers to Concede \\%", "Gains to Turnover Differential"
    ))) %>%
    arrange(Metric)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTION: MATCH BREAKDOWN (New)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
calc_gn_to_match_table <- function(df) {
  
  # --- TARGETS (Using 'Total' targets for full matches) ---
  target_gains_cnt  <- 24    
  target_gains_conv <- 0.75 
  target_to_cnt     <- 20    

  # A. CALCULATE RAW STATS
  stats_match <- df %>%
    filter(Row %in% c("SGP Gains", "SGP Turnovers")) %>%
    group_by(Opponent, Row) %>%
    summarise(
      Count = n(),
      Success_Gain = sum(Row == "SGP Gains" & str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "SGP Goal"), na.rm=TRUE),
      Concede_TO   = sum(Row == "SGP Turnovers" & str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "OPP Goal"), na.rm=TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% 
    arrange(match_order[Opponent]) %>%
    mutate(Opponent = factor(Opponent, levels = unique(Opponent)))

  # B. PIVOT & CALCULATE
  formatted_table <- stats_match %>%
    mutate(Row = str_replace_all(Row, " ", "_")) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Row, values_from = c(Count, Success_Gain, Concede_TO), values_fill = 0) %>%
    mutate(
      # Safely handle missing columns if a match had 0 gains/turnovers
      Count_SGP_Gains = if("Count_SGP_Gains" %in% names(.)) Count_SGP_Gains else 0,
      Success_Gain_SGP_Gains = if("Success_Gain_SGP_Gains" %in% names(.)) Success_Gain_SGP_Gains else 0,
      Count_SGP_Turnovers = if("Count_SGP_Turnovers" %in% names(.)) Count_SGP_Turnovers else 0,
      Concede_TO_SGP_Turnovers = if("Concede_TO_SGP_Turnovers" %in% names(.)) Concede_TO_SGP_Turnovers else 0,
      
      Metric_Gains = Count_SGP_Gains,
      Metric_Gains_Conv = ifelse(Count_SGP_Gains > 0, Success_Gain_SGP_Gains / Count_SGP_Gains, 0),
      Metric_TO = Count_SGP_Turnovers,
      Metric_TO_Concede = ifelse(Count_SGP_Turnovers > 0, Concede_TO_SGP_Turnovers / Count_SGP_Turnovers, 0),
      Metric_Diff = Metric_Gains - Metric_TO
    ) %>%
    
    # C. FORMATTING
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      Display_Gains = {
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_Gains >= target_gains_cnt, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_Gains), "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_Gains_Conv = {
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_Gains_Conv >= target_gains_conv, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        val_str <- paste0(round(Metric_Gains_Conv * 100), "%") 
        if(Count_SGP_Gains == 0) "-" else cell_spec(val_str, "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_TO = {
        color_bg <- ifelse(Metric_TO <= target_to_cnt, "#57BB8A", "#E67C73")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_TO), "latex", color = "white", bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      },
      Display_TO_Concede = {
        val_str <- paste0(round(Metric_TO_Concede * 100), "\\%")
        if(Count_SGP_Turnovers == 0) "-" else val_str
      },
      Display_Diff = {
        color_bg <- case_when(
          Metric_Diff > 0 ~ "#57BB8A", 
          Metric_Diff < 0 ~ "#E67C73", 
          TRUE            ~ "white"    
        )
        color_text <- ifelse(Metric_Diff == 0, "black", "white")
        cell_spec(as.character(Metric_Diff), "latex", color = color_text, bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(Opponent, Display_Gains, Display_Gains_Conv, Display_TO, Display_TO_Concede, Display_Diff) %>%
    
    # D. RESHAPE
    pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("Display"), names_to = "Metric_Code", values_to = "Value") %>%
    mutate(
      Metric = case_when(
        Metric_Code == "Display_Gains" ~ "Gains",
        Metric_Code == "Display_Gains_Conv" ~ "Gains Conversion \\%",
        Metric_Code == "Display_TO" ~ "Turnovers",
        Metric_Code == "Display_TO_Concede" ~ "Turnovers to Concede \\%",
        Metric_Code == "Display_Diff" ~ "Gains to Turnover Differential"
      )
    ) %>%
    select(Opponent, Metric, Value) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = Opponent, values_from = Value) %>%
    
    mutate(Metric = factor(Metric, levels = c(
      "Gains", "Gains Conversion \\%", "Turnovers", "Turnovers to Concede \\%", "Gains to Turnover Differential"
    ))) %>%
    arrange(Metric)
}

# 3. GENERATE AND RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
table_quarterly <- calc_gn_to_table(data)
table_match <- calc_gn_to_match_table(data)


kable(table_quarterly, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      col.names = c("Metrics", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total"),
      caption = "SGP Gains \\& Turnovers (Quarterly)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:6, width = "1.5cm", latex_valign = "m") %>%
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>% 
  footnote(
    general = sprintf(
      "Based on %d matches. Targets: Gains $\\\\geq$ %d/qtr; Turnovers $\\\\leq$ %d/qtr; Conversion $\\\\geq$ 75\\\\%%.",
      n_matches, comp_kpi_gains_qtr, comp_kpi_to_qtr
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  )

kable(table_match, 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      caption = "SGP Gains \\& Turnovers (Per Match)") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down")) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:ncol(table_match), width = "2cm", latex_valign = "m") %>%
  column_spec(ncol(table_match), bold = TRUE) %>% 
  row_spec(0, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r sgp_gains_reasons_plot, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.align='center',out.width='100%'}
# 1. DEFINE STANDARD COLORS (Global Palette)

# 3. PLOT

      title = "Breakdown of Gain Reasons by Player",

      legend.key.size = unit(0.4, "cm"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )
  
} else {

}
```

# GAINS vs TURNOVERS DIFFERENTIAL (OVERALL)

```{r sgp_gn_to_differential, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# 1. DEFINE TARGET METRICS & ORDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
target_metrics <- c(
  "Interception",
  "Pass Out of Bounds",
  "Dropped Ball",
  "Stepping",
  "Contact",
  "Held",
  "Over Third",
  "Offside",
  "Obstruction",
  "Repossession",
  "Breaking",
  "Short Pass",
  "Missed Shot Rebound",
  "Missed Shot Out of Bounds",
  "Centre Positioned Incorrectly",
  "Pickups"
)

# 2. DATA PROCESSING
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
diff_data <- data %>%
  filter(Row %in% c("SGP Gains", "SGP Turnovers")) %>%
  separate_rows(`Gains / Turnover Reason`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
  mutate(Reason_Raw = str_trim(`Gains / Turnover Reason`)) %>%
  
  # --- ROBUST MAPPING ---
  mutate(Reason = case_when(
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Intercept", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Interception",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Drop.*Ball", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Dropped Ball",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Missed Rebound", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Missed Shot Rebound",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Shot Out of Bounds", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Missed Shot Out of Bounds",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Pass Out", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Pass Out of Bounds",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Held", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Held",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Over.*Third", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Over Third",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Short Pass", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Short Pass",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Breaking", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Breaking",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Contact", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Contact",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Obstruction", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Obstruction",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Offside", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Offside",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Repossession", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Repossession",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Stepping", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Stepping",
    str_detect(Reason_Raw, regex("Pickups", ignore_case = T)) ~ "Pickups",
    TRUE ~ Reason_Raw
  )) %>%
  
  filter(Reason %in% target_metrics) %>%
  group_by(Reason, Row) %>%
  summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Row, values_from = Count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  
  rename_with(~ "Gains", any_of("SGP Gains")) %>%
  rename_with(~ "Turnovers", any_of("SGP Turnovers")) %>%
  
  bind_rows(tibble(Reason = character(), Gains = numeric(), Turnovers = numeric())) %>%
  mutate(Gains = replace_na(Gains, 0), Turnovers = replace_na(Turnovers, 0)) %>%
  
  full_join(tibble(Reason = target_metrics), by = "Reason") %>%
  replace_na(list(Gains = 0, Turnovers = 0)) %>%
  
  mutate(Differential = Gains - Turnovers) %>%
  mutate(Reason = factor(Reason, levels = target_metrics)) %>%
  arrange(Reason) %>%
  mutate(
    Turnovers  = if_else(Reason == "Pickups",      NA_real_, Turnovers),
    
    Differential = case_when(
      Reason == "Pickups"      ~ Gains,
      TRUE                     ~ Gains - Turnovers
    )
  ) %>% 
  
  # --- CONDITIONAL FORMATTING ---
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(Differential = {
    # 1. Define Background Color
    color_bg <- case_when(
      Differential > 0 ~ "#57BB8A", # Green
      Differential < 0 ~ "#E67C73", # Red
      TRUE             ~ "white"    # White
    )
    
    # 2. Define Text Color (White on color, Black on white)
    color_text <- ifelse(Differential == 0, "black", "white")
    
    # 3. Apply Formatting
    cell_spec(Differential, "latex", color = color_text, bold = TRUE, background = color_bg)
  }) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  
  select(Metrics = Reason, Gains, Turnovers, Differential)

# 3. RENDER TABLE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
kable(diff_data, 
      format = "latex", 
      booktabs = TRUE, 
      escape = FALSE,
      align = c("l", "c", "c", "c"), 
      caption = "Gains vs Turnovers Differential (Overall)") %>%
  # REMOVED "striped" TO FIX COLOR CONFLICT
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>% 
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE, width = "6.5cm") %>%
  column_spec(2:4, width = "2.5cm", latex_valign = "m")
```

# OVERALL COURT LOCATION for GN/TOs

```{r sgp_court_locations, echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=6, fig.align='center'}

# 1. DEFINE COURT MAPPING (18 TILES)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# We map text labels to (x, y) coordinates.
# X: 1=Left, 2=Middle, 3=Right
# Y: 1-2 (Defense), 3-4 (Centre), 5-6 (Attack)

court_map <- tribble(
  ~Location,                   ~x, ~y, ~Zone_Label,

  # --- DEFENSIVE THIRD (Rows 1-2) ---
  "Defensive Left Pocket",      1, 1, "DL Pocket",
  "Defensive D",                2, 1, "Def Circle",
  "Defensive Right Pocket",     3, 1, "DR Pocket",
  "Defensive Left",             1, 2, "Def Left",
  "Defensive Middle",           2, 2, "Def Mid",
  "Defensive Right",            3, 2, "Def Right",

  # --- CENTRE THIRD (Rows 3-4) ---
  "Center Left Defense",        1, 3, "C Left (D)",
  "Center Mid Defense",         2, 3, "C Mid (D)",
  "Center Right Defense",       3, 3, "C Right (D)",
  "Center Left Attack",         1, 4, "C Left (A)",
  "Center Mid Attack",          2, 4, "C Mid (A)",
  "Center Right Attack",        3, 4, "C Right (A)",

  # --- ATTACKING THIRD (Rows 5-6) ---
  "Attacking Left",             1, 5, "Att Left",
  "Attacking Middle",           2, 5, "Att Mid",
  "Attacking Right",            3, 5, "Att Right",
  "Attacking Left Pocket",      1, 6, "AL Pocket",
  "Attacking D",                2, 6, "Att Circle",
  "Attacking Right Pocket",     3, 6, "AR Pocket"
)

# 2. HELPER FUNCTION: GENERATE HEATMAP (WITH CRASH FIX)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
generate_court_heatmap <- function(target_row, plot_title, low_col, high_col) {
  
  # A. Prepare Data with Exclusions
  loc_data <- data %>%
    filter(Row == target_row) %>%
    
    # --- SAFETY BLOCK: Handle Mismatched Lists ---
    # This prevents the "size 6 to size 4" error by padding the shorter list
    mutate(
      # Treat NAs as empty strings
      `Turnover Location` = replace_na(`Turnover Location`, ""),
      `Gains / Turnover Reason` = replace_na(`Gains / Turnover Reason`, ""),
      
      # Count number of items (commas + 1)
      n_loc = str_count(`Turnover Location`, ",") + 1,
      n_reason = str_count(`Gains / Turnover Reason`, ",") + 1,
      diff = n_loc - n_reason,
      
      # Pad Reason if it's shorter than Location
      `Gains / Turnover Reason` = ifelse(diff > 0, 
                                         paste0(`Gains / Turnover Reason`, str_dup(", Unknown", diff)), 
                                         `Gains / Turnover Reason`),
      
      # Pad Location if it's shorter than Reason (Rare)
      `Turnover Location` = ifelse(diff < 0, 
                                   paste0(`Turnover Location`, str_dup(", Unknown", abs(diff))), 
                                   `Turnover Location`)
    ) %>%
    # ---------------------------------------------
    
    # Robustness: Separate BOTH Location and Reason to ensure they stay aligned
    separate_rows(`Turnover Location`, `Gains / Turnover Reason`, sep = ",\\s*") %>%
    
    # Clean Strings
    mutate(
      Location = str_trim(`Turnover Location`),
      Reason = str_trim(`Gains / Turnover Reason`)
    ) %>%
    
    # # --- LOGIC UPDATE: APPLY EXCLUSIONS ---
    # filter(case_when(
    #   # For Gains: Exclude "Shot Out of Bounds"
    #   target_row == "SGP Gains" ~ !str_detect(Reason, regex("Shot Out of Bounds", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    #   
    #   # For Turnovers: Exclude "Missed Shots" (Missed Rebound & Shot Out of Bounds)
    #   target_row == "SGP Turnovers" ~ !str_detect(Reason, regex("Missed Rebound|Shot Out of Bounds", ignore_case = TRUE)),
    #   
    #   # Default: Keep everything else
    #   TRUE ~ TRUE
    # )) %>%
    # --------------------------------------

    # Count frequencies
    group_by(Location) %>%
    summarise(Count = n(), .groups = "drop")
  
  # B. Join with Map
  # Right join keeps all 18 court tiles even if Count is 0
  plot_data <- court_map %>%
    left_join(loc_data, by = "Location") %>%
    replace_na(list(Count = 0))
  
  # C. Plot
  ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = x, y = y, fill = Count)) +
    # Draw Tiles
    geom_tile(color = "white", size = 1) +
    
    # Add Text Labels (Count)
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(Count > 0, Count, "")), 
              color = "black", fontface = "bold", size = 5) +
    
    # Add Zone Labels (Small, for reference)
    geom_text(aes(label = Zone_Label), 
              color = "grey30", size = 2.5, vjust = 2.5) +
    
    # Visuals: Court Lines (Thirds)
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(2.5, 4.5), color = "black", size = 1, linetype = "solid") +
    
    # Coloring
    scale_fill_gradient(low = low_col, high = high_col) +
    
    # Fix Aspect Ratio to look like a court (approx 1:2 ratio for 3x6 grid)
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1) +
    
    # Styling
    theme_void() + # Remove axes
    labs(
      title = plot_title,
      fill = "Count"
    ) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(b = 10)),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

# 3. GENERATE PLOTS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Plot 1: SGP Gains (Green Scale)
p_gains <- generate_court_heatmap("SGP Gains", "Location Frequency: SGP Gains", "#DDDDDD", "#31a354")

# Plot 2: SGP Turnovers (Red Scale)
p_turnovers <- generate_court_heatmap("SGP Turnovers", "Location Frequency: SGP Turnovers", "#DDDDDD", "#de2d26")

# 4. ARRANGE SIDE-BY-SIDE
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
grid.arrange(p_gains, p_turnovers, ncol = 2)
```
