# PENALTY SUMMARY

```{r penalty_summary_colored}
# 1. CRITICAL: Force LaTeX format so cell_spec generates the correct coloring code
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CALCULATE DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
penalty_table <-  data %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Row, "PEN")) %>% 
  # counts by team, quarter and penalty reason
  count(Row, Quarter, `Penalty Reason`) %>% 
  # Ensure all quarters exist
  complete(Row, Quarter = c("Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4"), `Penalty Reason`,
           fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter,
              values_from = n,
              values_fill = 0) %>%   #account for rows with no such combinations
  # get totals
  mutate(Total = Q1 + Q2 + Q3 + Q4) %>% 
  # get sgp and opp totals per quarter per reason
  bind_rows(
    summarise(., `Penalty Reason` = "Total",
              across(c(Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Total), sum),
              .by = Row)
  ) %>% 
  # factor rows for total to be at the top
  mutate(`Penalty Reason` = factor(`Penalty Reason`,
                                   levels = c("Total", "Contact", "Obstruction"))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(`Penalty Reason`)) %>%     
  # change row names to team names
  mutate(Row = recode(Row, "SGP PEN" = meta_team_name, "OPP PEN" = meta_opponent_name),
         Row = factor(Row, levels = c(meta_team_name, meta_opponent_name))) %>% 
  arrange(Row, `Penalty Reason`)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. FORMATTING LOGIC (REVERSED: Negative = Green, Positive = Red)
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

format_pen_diff <- function(val) {
  # Logic: Green if Negative (< 0), Red if Zero or Positive
  if (val < 0) {
    color_bg <- "#57BB8A" # Green (fewer penalties is good)
  } else {
    color_bg <- "#E67C73" # Red (more penalties is bad)
  }
  
  # Generate the LaTeX code for coloring
  cell_spec(val, "latex", 
            color = "white", 
            bold = TRUE, 
            background = color_bg)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. PREPARE TABLE ROWS
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Get penalty differences only for team totals per quarter and per game 
# NOTE: Negative is good for penalties
penalty_diff <- penalty_table %>% 
  filter(`Penalty Reason` == "Total") %>% 
  summarise(across(c(Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Total),
                   ~ .x[Row == meta_team_name] - .x[Row == meta_opponent_name])) %>% 
  # Apply formatting (only for differential row)
  mutate(across(everything(), format_pen_diff)) %>%
  mutate(`Penalty Reason` = "Differential (Total)", Row = "Differential (Total)")

# Change pentalty table to chr to match cell styling in differential table
penalty_table_chr <- penalty_table %>% 
  mutate(across(c(Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4, Total), as.character))

# Final table
final_table <- bind_rows(penalty_table_chr, penalty_diff)


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. RENDER
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# Render Table
final_table %>% 
  select(-Row) %>%
  kable(booktabs = TRUE,
        align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
        col.names = c("", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total"),
        escape = FALSE,
        caption = "Penalty Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>%          
  pack_rows(index = table(penalty_table$Row)) %>%
  row_spec(6, hline_after = TRUE) %>%
  row_spec(which(penalty_table$`Penalty Reason` == "Total"), bold = TRUE)

```

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 1. CALCULATE DATA

# get deflection summary
deflection_table <- data %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Row, "Deflection")) %>%   
  group_by(Row, Quarter) %>% 
  summarise(
    Attempts = n(),
    Successes = sum(`Deflection Success` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  mutate(`Success %` = if_else(Attempts > 0,
                               sprintf("%.1f%%", Successes / Attempts * 100),
                               "0.0"),
         Attempts = as.character(Attempts),
         Successes = as.character(Successes)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Attempts, Successes, `Success %`),
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "val") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Quarter, values_from = val)


# Get totals for each team with % calculations
totals <- data %>% 
  filter(str_detect(Row, "Deflection")) %>%   
  group_by(Row) %>% 
  summarise(Attempts = n(),
            Successes = sum(`Deflection Success` == "Yes", na.rm = TRUE),
            .groups = "drop") %>% 
  mutate(`Success %` = if_else(Attempts > 0,
                               sprintf("%.1f%%", Successes / Attempts * 100),
                               "0.0"),
         Attempts = as.character(Attempts),
         Successes = as.character(Successes)) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(Attempts, Successes, `Success %`),
               names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Total")

combined_table <- left_join(deflection_table, totals, by= c("Row", "Metric")) %>% 
  mutate(Row = recode(Row, "SGP Deflection" = meta_team_name,
                      "OPP Deflection" = meta_opponent_name),
         Row = factor(Row, levels = c(meta_team_name, meta_opponent_name))) %>% 
  mutate(Metric = recode(Metric, 
                         "Attempts" = "Deflections",
                         "Successes" = "Deflections to Gain",
                         "Success %" = "Deflections to Gain %")) %>% 
  arrange(Row) %>% 
  mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ case_when(
    is.na(.x) & Metric == "Deflections to Gain %" ~ "0.0%",
    is.na(.x) ~ "0",
    TRUE ~ .x
  )))


# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. RENDER TABLE

combined_table %>%
  select(-Row) %>%
  kable(booktabs = TRUE,
        align = c("l", "c", "c", "c", "c", "c"),
        col.names = c("", "Q1", "Q2", "Q3", "Q4", "Total"),
        caption = "Deflection Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(
    latex_options = c("hold_position", "scale_down"), 
    full_width = FALSE, 
    position = "center"
  ) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>%        
  column_spec(6, bold = TRUE) %>%

# KPI SUMMARY

```{r KPI_summary}
# 1. CRITICAL: Force LaTeX format so cell_spec generates the correct coloring code
options(knitr.table.format = "latex")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 2. HELPER FUNCTION 
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

conv_rate <- function(row_name, outcome = "SGP Goal") {
  df <- data %>% filter(Row == row_name)
  round(sum(str_detect(df$`Shot Outcome`, outcome), na.rm = TRUE) / nrow(df), 2)
}

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 3. CALCULATE DATA
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kpi_shooting <- shots_long %>% 
  filter(Row == "SGP Shot") %>% 
  filter(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal|Miss")) %>% 
  summarise(pct = mean(str_detect(`Shot Outcome`, "Goal"))) %>% 
  pull(pct) %>% 
  round(2)

kpi_ce_feed <- feeds_long %>% 
  filter(Row == "SGP Feed") %>% 
  filter(`Feed Location` == "Circle Edge") %>% 
  summarise(pct = mean(str_detect(`Feed Success`, "YES"))) %>% 
  pull(pct) %>% 
  round(2)


kpi_cpa        <- conv_rate("SGP CPA")
kpi_dcpa <- conv_rate("SGP DCPA")
kpi_gains_conv <- conv_rate("SGP Gains")
kpi_gains <- sum(data$Row == "SGP Gains")
kpi_tos        <- sum(data$Row == "SGP Turnovers")

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Format Table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# --- Colorise ---
kpi_cell <- function(text, ok) {
  bg <- if (ok) "#57BB8A" else "#E67C73"
  cell_spec(text, "latex", color = "black", bold = TRUE, background = bg)
}

kpi_df <- tibble(
  KPI = c("Shooting \\%", "Circle Edge Feed \\%", "CPA Conversion \\%",
          "DCPA Conversion \\%", "Total Gains", "Gains Conversion \\%",
          "Total Turnovers"),
  Target = c("$\\geq$ 90\\%", "$\\geq$ 90\\%", "$\\geq$ 80\\%",
             "$\\geq$ 75\\%",
             sprintf("$\\geq$ %d", comp_kpi_gains),
             "$\\geq$ 75\\%", 
             sprintf("$\\leq$ %d", comp_kpi_to)),
  Actual = c(
    kpi_cell(sprintf("%.0f%%", kpi_shooting * 100),   kpi_shooting   >= 0.90),
    kpi_cell(sprintf("%.0f%%", kpi_ce_feed * 100),    kpi_ce_feed    >= 0.90),
    kpi_cell(sprintf("%.0f%%", kpi_cpa * 100),        kpi_cpa        >= 0.80),
    kpi_cell(sprintf("%.0f%%", kpi_dcpa * 100),       kpi_dcpa       >= 0.75),
    kpi_cell(as.character(kpi_gains),                 kpi_gains      >= comp_kpi_gains),
    kpi_cell(sprintf("%.0f%%", kpi_gains_conv * 100), kpi_gains_conv >= 0.75),
    kpi_cell(as.character(kpi_tos),                   kpi_tos        <= comp_kpi_to)
  )
)

# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 4. Render Table
# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------

kable(kpi_df, booktabs = TRUE, escape = FALSE, align = "lcc",
      caption = "Competition KPI Summary") %>%
  kable_styling(latex_options = c("hold_position"), full_width = FALSE) %>%
  column_spec(1, bold = TRUE) %>% 
  footnote(
    general = sprintf(
      "Based on %d matches. Targets: Gains %d total; Turnovers %d total",
      n_matches, comp_kpi_gains, comp_kpi_to
    ),
    general_title = "Note: ",
    footnote_as_chunk = TRUE,
    escape = FALSE
  )

```
